title: Fix Manage All Tickets so an Admin can directly type an agent name into REASSIGN
description: If in the Admin Set up -> Manage All tickets, if anyone is Assigning a ticket and writing the assigned person name and changing the Status to assign don't give an error. Let the ticket be assigned to the concerned person

todos.label: Allow direct Open→Assigned transition when the agent is entered via REASSIGN_TO_AGENT
Persist the entered agent into ASSIGNED_AGENT when status is saved as Assigned via direct edit
